_comment: Tower is a printed keyword from the card DB (printed_keywords), not authored here. The static applies -1{d} to each non-equipment defending card while this attack has 13+ power. WHILE_STATIC on RECALC_DEFENSE is dispatched once per defender; DEFENDING_CARD_IS with equipment:false scopes the effect to non-equipment defenders only. SELF_ATTACK_POWER_GTE checks the live attack power at each recalculation, so power increases after defense declaration retroactively apply the penalty (per release notes).
